resources.string: Review and explicitly apply supported Android privacy controls. No changes are made until you change a control.
This Settings page is unavailable on this build.
Experimental AOSP-based build. GrapheneOS-inspired appearance does not provide GrapheneOS device hardening. Per-app permissions and remaining privacy controls stay in Android Settings.
Allows GhostOS to apply explicitly selected camera, screen-capture, microphone, location and supported USB data restrictions when provisioned as Device Owner. No policy is applied automatically.
Device Owner is active. Supported camera, screen-capture, microphone, location and USB data controls can be changed individually below. Full GhostMode remains inactive.
Device Owner provisioning is required before these Android-enforced controls can be changed. No policy is applied automatically.
The GhostMode device administrator is inactive. No policy was changed.
Android DevicePolicyManager is unavailable or policy state could not be read. No protection is assumed.

These are individual Device Owner controls only. Location control appears only on Android 11 or later; USB data control appears only when Android reports device support. Network, clipboard, per-app permissions and notification protections are not yet enforced by GhostMode.
USB data signaling disabled; charging remains available.
Android rejected the change; the previous state was restored.
Policy change failed and rollback was incomplete. Verify Android policy state before relying on protection.

Opens GhostOS Privacy Center. Supported Device Owner camera, microphone, location, screen-capture and USB data controls are available individually after provisioning. Remaining GhostMode controls are not connected or enforced yet. This tile is not an activation switch.
